summary: Phase 149O.1A -- Human Approval Trusted Provenance Contract & Trust-Boundary Architecture: human-approval trust-boundary architecture plus normative contract design (contract freeze deferred). Independently re-verified 149O.1's trust inventory from primary source (PublicationCoordinator.authorize()/execute() at src/pcae/governance/publication/coordinator.py:91-211, acquire_agent_lock() at src/pcae/core/agent.py:288-306, a repo-wide grep for signing/hardware/credential primitives, and pyproject.toml's single jsonschema dependency), finding no discrepancy. Confirmed by reading RAE-001 Sec.22/Sec.6 directly that threat #2 ('Agent-generated fake approval JSON', citing RAE-REQ-018) is a genuine technical claim distinct from threat #3's already-disclosed identity gap, and found no primary-source contradiction licensing a downgrade to procedural-only provenance -- Model E (procedural-only) explicitly rejected, not selected as a shortcut. Evaluated five candidate trust models (A: hardware-backed external signing key: B: OS keychain with fresh per-use presence; C: external approval service; D: separate local privileged approver; E: procedural-only) against the mandatory dual-attack acceptance model (artifact forgery, legitimate-interface abuse), self-enrollment attack, and verifier-key-replacement attack. Selected HATP MODEL A for Root 1 (proof-production): a FIDO2/PIV-class hardware security device whose firmware enforces a fresh physical touch per signing operation and whose private key never leaves the device -- mechanically unsatisfiable by an unattended software process regardless of this repository's confirmed lack of OS-level human/agent separation (re-confirmed: no getpass.getuser(), no sys.stdin.isatty() gate, no OS-user check anywhere in the governance/publication/RAE path). Root 2 (verification/bootstrap) splits into two sub-facts: device-genuineness (resolved -- a fixed, externally-published vendor attestation root, not derived from local PCAE state) and approver-authorization mapping (UNRESOLVED in this repository's actual current deployment -- single OS user, no verified external service, no verified external human-gated review boundary exists today). Per the governing phase prompt's own decision rule ('If proof-production root is strong but verifier/bootstrap root remains agent-writable -> do not freeze, resolve bootstrap trust first'), this phase does NOT freeze HATP-001 v1.0 and does not create docs/contracts/HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT.md. Produced the full architecture document (docs/PHASE_149O_1A_HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARY_ARCHITECTURE.md) covering: required security property; four-fact identity/presence/authentication/authorization separation; candidate-model evaluation table; formal Root 1/Root 2 trust statement; dual-attack/self-enrollment/verifier-replacement analysis; required HATP proof payload (Decision digest, Binding digest -- mandatory concrete operation binding per item 13, AG3 job_id/original_commit_sha or AG5 per_id/ecp_id, approver principal, issued_at, proof version); approval-authority scope (repository-specific, narrowest currently-supported granularity); freshness/TTL relationship to RAE's existing 24-hour window; proof verification status vocabulary; repository binding (deferred, non-blocking -- no stable canonical repository identity exists in this codebase today); bootstrap-trust mandatory answers and three candidate (unselected) bootstrap-boundary mechanisms; fail-closed/headless behavior; mandatory trust capability matrix; layering compatibility assessments (RAE-001/CHGR-001/IWC-001/AESIC-001/PBPC-001/PBPA-001 all COMPATIBLE AS-IS, unamended); and thirteen future acceptance tests for the eventual implementation phase. Zero production code changed this phase (git status --short confirms zero src/pcae/** diff). B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN, unchanged from 149O.1. Mandatory trust capability matrix and root trust statement recorded. AG3/AG5 remain unwired; RAE-001/RWMPC-001/PBPC-001/PBPA-001/CHGR-001 all byte-unchanged; Runtime remains Observed/observe/unavailable throughout (confirmed via pcae runtime inspect before and during this phase). Evidence substrate readiness: NOT READY (unchanged from 149O.1). See docs/PHASE_149O_1A_HUMAN_APPROVAL_TRUSTED_PROVENANCE_CONTRACT_AND_TRUST_BOUNDARY_ARCHITECTURE.md.
